newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy petroleum product use falls in 1997 H1.
newsitem.headline: Italy petroleum product use falls in 1997 H1.

text.p: Italian consumption of petroleum products fell 4.1 percent to 45.4 million tonnes in the first half of 1997 compared to the first six months last year, according to data from trade group Unione Petrolifera (UP).
In June, consumption declined 2.2 percent year-on-year to 7.2 million tonnes, UP said in a statement.
The fall last month was mainly due to a sharp 17.6 percent drop in consumption of fuel oil for use by the power generating sector.
June demand for gasoline and diesel for the auto sector rose respectively by 3.4 percent to 1.5 million tonnes and by 2.5 percent to 1.3 million tonnes.
June sales of lead-free gasoline, at 728,000 tonnes, exceeded for the first time 50 percent of total petrol consumption, UP said.
